prompts.title: The Animated Captain
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality 3D animated portrait of a person with natural-length hair and large, expressive brown eyes. The subject has a serious, determined, and confident expression. They are wearing an incredibly detailed Argentina national football team jersey featuring classic white and light blue vertical stripes, a golden AFA crest on the left chest, a central Sun of May emblem, and black trim on the collar and sleeves. The subject is holding a modern, colorful World Cup-style soccer ball tucked confidently under their right arm.
The camera angle is eye-level, capturing a medium close-up portrait from the waist up in a perfectly symmetrical, centered composition. The background features a shallow depth of field with beautiful bokeh, revealing a crowded, massive football stadium filled with out-of-focus cheering fans wearing Argentina colors. Bright stadium floodlights shine in the distance against a vibrant twilight sky blending from sunset yellow to dusk blue.
Cinematic golden-hour lighting with a soft rim light illuminating the edges of the subject's hair. Rendered in Unreal Engine 5, Octane Render style, stylized 3D animation, Pixar or Valorant aesthetic, 8K resolution, hyper-detailed textures, and incredibly sharp focus on the main subject.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: FIFA Mid-Air Connection
prompts.prompt:
Create a dynamic, ultra-realistic sports action photograph of an elite football player wearing the Brazil national team kit, captured at the precise moment of striking a football during a professional match. Full-body vertical composition, low-angle perspective, emphasizing athletic power, speed, and explosive movement. The player is positioned centrally in the frame, wearing Brazil’s iconic bright yellow jersey with green trim, green shorts, white knee-high socks with green and yellow accents, and blue football boots. His support leg is firmly planted on the turf while the kicking leg swings through with tremendous force, moments after contact with the ball. His arms are naturally extended for balance, highlighting muscular definition, tension, and athletic form.
The football is shown in motion immediately after impact, traveling away from the player. Dirt, grass, turf fragments, and tiny debris erupt from the ground around the planted foot and striking zone, creating a dramatic sense of energy and realism. Subtle motion blur is applied to the kicking leg and ball to enhance speed, while the player’s face remains razor-sharp, displaying intense concentration and determination. His eyes are locked on the ball, and his windswept hair adds to the dynamic movement of the scene.
Background: A packed football stadium filled with passionate supporters dressed in Brazil’s national colors. Brazilian flags are visible throughout the crowd. The spectators, banners, and stadium architecture are softly blurred through a shallow depth of field, creating strong subject separation while maintaining the atmosphere of a major international football match.
Lighting: Dramatic golden-hour sunlight streams from the upper-left corner of the frame, producing warm cinematic backlighting and a radiant glow across the scene. Strong rim lighting outlines the player’s hair, shoulders, arms, and jersey edges. Floating dust particles, illuminated grass fragments, and tiny airborne debris catch the sunlight, creating sparkling highlights throughout the image. Rich golden tones, realistic shadows, vibrant color contrast, and natural lens flare enhance the cinematic atmosphere.
Style: Hyper-realistic sports photography, FIFA World Cup atmosphere, cinematic action shot, professional sports advertising campaign, ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric folds, visible jersey stitching, photorealistic skin detail, high dynamic range, sharp focus on the athlete, shallow depth of field, premium editorial sports aesthetic, dramatic and inspiring mood, 8K resolution, masterpiece quality.
Camera & Composition: Full-body vertical framing, low-angle field-level viewpoint, telephoto sports lens, fast shutter speed, professional sports photography, cinematic depth, realistic perspective, highly detailed grass texture, immersive stadium environment.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: The Golden Football Champion
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 3:4 vertical world football championship 2026 promotional poster using the uploaded image only for face and identity reference. Preserve the person’s facial identity, face shape, hairstyle, beard, skin texture, eyes, and natural expression with high accuracy.

The subject stands confidently in the center, shown from waist to head, facing the camera with a serious, calm, leadership expression. He wears a premium bright yellow football jersey with realistic fabric texture and a black-and-white captain armband on one arm. Both hands hold a glowing metallic golden football at chest level, with realistic fingers, grip, highlights, and reflections.

Behind him, create a large cinematic double-exposure side-profile portrait of the same person, facing toward the right horizon with a determined and ambitious look. Add huge soft-gold “2026” typography in the background, clean dark black-and-gold poster layout, luxury sports branding style, and a small trophy-inspired icon near the top. Add vertical championship text along the right side and a small bottom slogan: “BELIEVE. CONQUER. LEAD.”

Use golden energy particles, sparks, light streaks, lens glow, and dynamic championship atmosphere around the football and subject. Lighting should be dramatic but clean, with sharp focus on the face, realistic skin detail, natural beard texture, detailed hair, premium retouching, and high-end sports magazine poster quality. Keep the design symmetrical, polished, cinematic, and professional, with a dark black-and-gold background and elite athlete advertising style.
